blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: On-policy distillation can transfer the reasoning capabilities of a strong teacher to a smaller student. However, distillation from a stronger teacher model faces two mismatches: its solutions may be difficult for a smaller student to imitate, and its token-level probabilities may be incompatible with, or even unavailable to, the student. Existing methods handle these settings through different forms of supervision. To this end, we propose Bridged Self-Distillation (BSD), a unified framework for distilling from any teacher that provides reasoning traces. The model to be distilled from, termed the external teacher, first provides a reasoning trace as privileged context, which can be generated in an offline fashion. The student generates rollouts without this context, while a copy of the student conditioned on it, serving as the self-teacher, scores the same rollouts in the student's own token space. BSD uses the resulting token-level guidance to adjust updates on unsuccessful rollouts, with a verifier providing the outcome signal. As the external teacher is queried only to produce text, the same training procedure applies to all teacher scenarios: shared-tokenizer, cross-tokenizer, and closed API teachers. Across these scenarios, BSD improves over the base model and outperforms baselines tailored to each scenario, offering a novel and unified pathway for distillation. Code is available: https://github.com/TUMLegalTech/Bridged-Self-Distillation
blocks.zh: 政策分解可以将强师生的推理能力转移给较小的学生. 然而,从更强的师范模式中分馏会面临两种不匹配的情况:其解决方案可能难以让较小的学生模仿,而其象征级的概率可能与学生不相容,甚至无法与学生相容. 现有方法通过不同形式的监督来处理这些设置. 为此,我们提议Bridged Self-Distillation(BSD),这是从任何提供推理痕迹的老师身上分馏出一个统一的框架. 从外部老师那里提炼出来的模型,首先提供了作为特权背景的推理痕迹,可以脱机生成. 学生在没有这种上下文的情况下产生"推出",而附条件于此的"学生"的复制品,作为自导自演,在学生自己的象征性空间中得分相同"推出". blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large reasoning models have become increasingly capable on tasks that require multi-step reasoning ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Ahn et al., 2024 ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) .
Much of this progress comes from post-training, typically including supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on reasoning traces and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Chung et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2025a ; Ye et al., 2025b ; Yu et al., 2025 ) .
Yet the cost of running a large reasoning model makes it desirable to transfer its capabilities to smaller student models that can respond more quickly and be deployed more widely ( Hinton et al., 2015 ; Kim and Rush, 2016 ) .
On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a promising post-training approach for this purpose, allowing a smaller model to learn from the guidance of a stronger teacher ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Ko et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Lu and Lab, 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Song and Zheng, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
大型推理模型越来越有能力完成需要多步骤推理的任务(Wei等,2022;Ahn等,2024;Muennighoff等,2025;Guo等,2025)。
大部分进展来自培训后,通常包括有监督地微调推理痕迹和有可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR)(Oyang等,2022;Chung等,2024;Shao等,2024;Ye等,2025a); Ye等,2025b;Yu等,2025).
然而运行大型推理模型的成本使得其能力可以被转移到更小的学生模型上,这些模型可以更快的响应并被更广泛的部署(Hinton等,2015;Kim和Rush,2016.).
政策蒸馏法(OPD)已作为这方面的一种有希望的后培训方法而出现,使一个较小的模型能够从更强的教师的指导下学习(Gu等,2024;Agarwal等,2024;Ko等,2024;Xu等,2025;Lu和Lab,2025;Li等,2026b;Song和Zheng,2026).

blocks.en:
In standard OPD, the student generates its own rollouts, and the teacher scores the student’s tokens to guide training ( Ross et al., 2011 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) .
This requires access to the teacher’s next-token distributions and a way to align them with the student’s tokenization.
However, when teacher and student use different tokenizers, these distributions cannot be compared directly; when the teacher is available only through a closed API, they may be inaccessible. Cross-tokenizer OPD methods address the former by constructing mappings between the token spaces of the student and teacher ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Minixhofer et al., 2025 ; Boizard et al., 2025 ; Niu et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , while black-box methods address the latter using feedback such as rubrics or sampled continuations ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2026a ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
These methods expand the range of usable teachers, but require different training signals for different teacher settings (Figure 1 , top).
Alternatively, SFT can train on teacher-generated text without accessing probabilities, although directly imitating a much stronger model’s reasoning can be difficult for a small student ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Lyu et al., 2026 ) .
This motivates a unified on-policy learning method that can distill from any teacher capable of providing reasoning traces .
blocks.zh:
在标准OPD中,学生自行出道,由老师给学生的道具打分指导训练(Ross等,2011;Agarwal等,2024;Jin等,2026;Wu等,2026).
这需要获得教师的下一张专辑,以及使这些专辑与学生的标志化相一致的方法。
然而,当师生使用不同的活化剂时,这些分布无法直接比较;当教师只能通过封闭的API获得时,它们可能无法进入. Cross-tokenizer OPD方法通过在学生和教师的象征性空间之间进行绘图来解决前者(张等,2024年;Minixhofer等,2025年;Boizard等,2025年;Niu等,2026年;Sun等,2026年;而黑盒方法则利用红宝石或样本续作等反馈处理后者(Jiang等,2023年;Ye等,2026a;Fang等,2026年;Xiong等,2026年;周等,2026年).
这些方法扩大了可用教师的范围,但要求不同的教师环境有不同的培训信号(图1,顶端)。
或者,SFT可以在不获取概率的情况下对教师生成的文本进行培训,尽管直接模仿一个更强大的模型的推理对于一个小学生来说可能很困难(张等,2023;张等,2025;黄等,2026;柳等,2026).
这激发了一种统一的政策学习方法,它可以从任何能够提供推理痕迹的教师那里提炼出来。

blocks.en:
We propose B ridged S elf- D istillation ( BSD ) to turn the reasoning of an external teacher into guidance on the student’s own rollouts (Figure 1 , bottom).
The external teacher is the model we aim to distill from, and BSD requires only its reasoning trace.
Instead of training the student to imitate the teacher’s solution, as in SFT, we provide that solution as privileged context to a copy of the student.
Inspired by on-policy self-distillation ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) , this conditioned copy serves as a self-teacher , scoring rollouts generated by the student
without the privileged context.
Both versions score the same tokens in the student’s own token space, and the differences show how access to the teacher’s reasoning changes the student’s predictions along its rollouts.
BSD uses these differences to adjust token-level penalties on unsuccessful rollouts, while a verifier determines the direction of the updates.
Because the external teacher provides only text, the same training procedure applies to shared-tokenizer, cross-tokenizer, and closed API teachers.
blocks.zh:
我们提议将外聘教师的推理转化为学生自己推出的指南(图1,下方)。
外部老师是我们想要从中提取的模型,而BSD只需要它的推理追踪.
我们没有像SFT那样训练学生模仿老师的解决方案,而是将这一解决方案作为学生的特有背景。
在政策自我消化的启发下(赵等,2026;张等,2026;杨等,2026a),此附条件的抄本起自导自演,由学生产生分数推出.
没有特殊的背景。
两个版本在学生自己的象征性空间中得分相同,不同之处表明进入老师的推理会如何改变学生在推出之后的预测.
BSD使用这些差异来调整不成功的推出时的符级处罚,而验证者则决定了更新的方向.
由于外部老师只提供文字,因此同样的培训程序适用于共享接吻器,交叉接吻器,以及关闭的API老师.

blocks.en:
We evaluate BSD under three forms of teacher access: (1) shared-tokenizer, (2) cross-tokenizer, and (3) closed API teachers.
Across twelve teacher–student pairs and three math reasoning benchmarks, BSD remains effective in all three settings while avoiding the severe degradation that SFT exhibits in several pairs.
Our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh:
我们通过三种形式对BSD进行教师准入评估:(1) 共享触控器,(2) 交叉触控器,(3) 封闭的API教师.
在整个十二个师生配对和三个数学推理基准中,BSD在所有三种环境下都依然有效,同时避免了SFT在多对中表现出的严重退化.
我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce BSD, a unified on-policy distillation framework that turns reasoning traces from external teachers into token-level guidance through a privileged self-teacher. • We evaluate BSD across twelve teacher–student pairs spanning shared-tokenizer, cross-tokenizer, and closed API teachers, demonstrating that BSD generally outperforms the baselines across all three settings. • Our analyses show that BSD maintains stable training, benefits from more complete reasoning traces, and concentrates its guidance on uncertain tokens, with stronger guidance associated with larger performance gains.

blocks.en: 3 Bridged Self-Distillation
blocks.zh: 3 桥式自旋

blocks.en:
To distill from teacher models with different tokenizers or text-only access, we need guidance that does not depend on their token probabilities.
Directly imitating a stronger teacher’s reasoning can also be difficult for a smaller student.
We therefore propose B ridged S elf- D istillation ( BSD ), which only needs a teacher’s reasoning trace and turns it into guidance on the student’s own rollouts (Figure 2 ).
We describe the key components below.
blocks.zh:
要从师范模型中提取出不同的活字器或仅限文本访问,我们需要不依赖于其活字概率的指导.
直接模仿更强的教师推理对较小的学生来说也可能是困难的.
因此,我们提议B摆脱Self-D闪烁(BSD),这只需要教师的推理跟踪,并将其转化为学生自己推出的指南(图2)。
我们叙述以下关键组成部分。

blocks.en: 3.1 External Teacher
blocks.zh: 3.1 外聘教师

blocks.en:
We refer to the model that we want to distill from as the external teacher .
Given a question x x , it provides a reasoning trace z z , the text it returns when solving x x , which contains its full reasoning when this is exposed and only its final response otherwise.
BSD uses z z as the privileged context for the self-teacher .
Because the external teacher only needs to provide text, this setup applies to all scenarios, including shared-tokenizer, cross-tokenizer, and closed API teachers.
blocks.zh:
我们提到我们想从外部老师那里提炼出来的模型。

BSD使用z z作为自我老师的特权背景.
由于外部老师只需要提供文本,这种设置适用于所有情景,包括共享触控器,交叉触控器,以及关闭的API老师.

For each generated token y t y_{t} , the student assigns the probability p t = π θ ​ ( y t ∣ x , y < t ) p_{t}=\pi_{\theta}(y_{t}\mid x,y_{<t}) .

As the two scores come from the same model and share the same token space, neither
logits from the external teacher nor vocabulary alignment is needed.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式

blocks.en:
Backbone models. We use three Qwen3 models as the student models ( Yang et al., 2025 ) (in thinking mode): Qwen3-0.6B , Qwen3-1.7B , and Qwen3-4B .
We also use Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as an additional backbone, which we first fine-tune on 1,000 reasoning traces
to enable it to produce reasoning blocks.
We refer to the fine-tuned model as Qwen3-4B-Instruct and use it as another student.
blocks.zh:
后骨模型. 我们使用三个"Quen3"模型作为学生模型(杨等,2025年)(在思考模式下):"Quen3-0.6B","Quen3-1.7B"和"Quen3-4B".
我们还使用Qune3-4B-Instruct-2507作为额外的骨干,我们首先微调了1000个推理痕迹
使其能够产生推理块。
我们把微调的模型称为"Quen3-4B-指示",并将其作为另一个学生使用.

blocks.en: Teacher models. We consider three models as external teachers with different access settings: Qwen3-32B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) as a shared-tokenizer teacher, Nemotron-3-30B-A3B ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) as a cross-tokenizer teacher, and GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) as a closed API teacher.
blocks.zh: 师范模特. 我们认为三种模式是具有不同使用环境的外部教师:Qune3-32B (Yang等,2025年)作为共享接吻老师,Nemotron-3-30B-A3B(NVIDIA等,2025年)作为交叉接吻老师,GPT-5.6 Luna(OpenAI,2026年)作为封闭式API老师.

blocks.en: 4.2 Training
blocks.zh: 4.2 培训

blocks.en:
Data. We use the mathematical reasoning subset of OpenThoughts ( Guha et al., 2026 ) .
For each teacher–student pair, we sample 2,400 training problems, and the external teacher provides one reasoning trace z z per problem.
The traces of Qwen3-32B and Nemotron-3-30B-A3B average about 4,000 tokens, while GPT-5.6 Luna returns only its final response, which averages 247 tokens.
blocks.zh:
数据。 我们使用OpenThoughts(Guha等,2026年)的数学推理子集.
每对教师, 我们抽样2,400个培训问题, 外聘教师提供每个问题一个推理痕量 z z 。
Qwen3-32B和Nemotron-3-30B-A3B的踪迹平均约为4000个令牌,而GPT-5.6 Luna只返回了最后的回放,平均为247个令牌.

blocks.en:
Implementation details. We implement BSD using verl ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) and vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) .
Each student model is trained for 150 updates
on NVIDIA H100/H200 GPUs.
Further details are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
执行细节。 我们使用verl(Sheng等人,2025年)和vLLM(Kwon等人,2023年)实施BSD。
每个学生模式都经过训练,可更新150个
在NVIDIA H100/H200GPU上.
详情见附录A。

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价

blocks.en:
Benchmarks. We evaluate on three competition-level mathematics benchmarks: AIME 2024 ( Mathematical Association of America, 2024 ) , AIME 2025 ( Mathematical Association of America, 2025 ) , and HMMT 2025 ( Dekoninck et al., 2026 ) .
We select the best checkpoints using a separate set of 128 development problems from OpenThoughts.

基准。 我们评价三个竞赛级别的数学基准:AIME 2024(美国数学协会,2024年),AIME 2025(美国数学协会,2025年)和HMMT 2025(德克宁克等,2026年).
我们从OpenThoughts中选择了一套128个发展问题的最好检查站。

blocks.en:
Metrics. For each benchmark problem, we generate four samples.
We report Avg@4, the average correctness of the four samples, in Table 1 , and Pass@4, the proportion of problems solved by at least one sample, in Table 14 .
The evaluation settings, the teachers’ own scores, and the selected checkpoints are in Appendices A and F .

我们在表1中报告Avg@4、四个样本的平均正确性,在表14中报告至少一个样本解决问题的比例。

blocks.en: 4.4 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.4 基线

blocks.en: We consider the following baselines, which use the same backbones and training problems as BSD.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑以下基线,这些基线使用与BSD相同的骨干与训练问题.

blocks.en: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). We train each student to imitate the external teacher’s reasoning traces ( Kim and Rush, 2016 ) using the same traces that serve as privileged context for BSD.
blocks.zh: 监督"精通" (SFT). 我们训练每个学生模仿外部老师的推理痕迹(Kim and Rush, 2016),

blocks.en: Vanilla OPD. For the shared-tokenizer teacher, we use standard OPD ( Lu and Lab, 2025 ) , which is optimized by minimizing the log-probability differences between student and teacher.
blocks.zh: 香草OPD. (原始内容存档于2018-10-12). 对于共享触控器老师,我们使用标准的OPD(Lu and Lab, 2025),通过将学生和老师之间的日志概率差异最小化来优化.

blocks.en: Cross-Tokenizer OPD (xOPD). For the cross-tokenizer teacher, we use cross-tokenizer OPD ( Niu et al., 2026 ) , denoted xOPD, which aligns the two tokenizations and maps teacher token log-probabilities onto student tokens.
blocks.zh: 交叉开关 OPD (xOPD). 对交叉触控器老师来说,我们使用交叉触控器OPD(Niu等,2026年),表示xOPD,它将两个标语相统一,并将老师的符号对数概率图到学生的符号上.

blocks.en: Rubric-Based OPD (ROPD). For the closed API teacher, we use ROPD ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , which asks the teacher to derive a rubric for each question and score the student’s rollouts against it.
blocks.zh: 鲁布里克-基于OPD(ROPD). 校对:Soup

blocks.en: 5 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5 主要结果

blocks.en:
We examine how BSD performs under different forms of teacher access.
Across twelve teacher–student pairs, we first compare BSD with SFT and the OPD baseline designed for each of the shared-tokenizer, cross-tokenizer, and closed API settings.
We then track performance and response length throughout training to examine how BSD and the baselines affect the student’s behavior.
blocks.zh:
我们研究BSD如何在不同的教师准入形式下进行。
在十二个师生对中, 我们首先比较了 BSD 和 SFT 以及 OPD 基线, 每个共享切换器、 交叉切换器和关闭的 API 设置。
然后我们跟踪整个培训的绩效和反应时间,以检查BSD和基线如何影响学生的行为。

blocks.en: 5.1 Comparing Teacher Access
blocks.zh: 5.1 教师入学比较

blocks.en:
BSD consistently improves over the base model and outperforms the distillation baselines across teacher settings. Table 1 reports Avg@4 for four students paired with shared-tokenizer, cross-tokenizer, and closed API teachers.
BSD improves over the base model in all twelve teacher–student pairs, with gains of 1.2 to 4.7 points, and achieves the best average score in eleven pairs.
blocks.zh:
BSD在基础模型上不断改进,并且超越了教师环境中的分馏基线。 表1为四名学生的Avg@4, 配对为共享切除器、交叉切除器和关闭的API教师。
BSD在所有12个师生对子中都比基模有所改进,得分为1.2到4.7分,并在11对中达到最佳平均分.

blocks.en:
Shared-tokenizer teacher. Qwen3-32B shares the students’ tokenizer, allowing vanilla OPD to score their rollouts directly with teacher token probabilities.
BSD outperforms SFT for all four students by 3.3 to 8.6 points in average score, while SFT falls below the base model for three of them.
Thus, even within the same model family, directly imitating a much stronger teacher’s reasoning can be difficult for smaller students ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
BSD also matches or outperforms vanilla OPD for every student: the two tie in average score for Qwen3-1.7B , and BSD scores up to 3.6 points higher for the other three.
This indicates that sharing a tokenizer does not ensure compatible reasoning patterns between distinct models, which prior work identifies as important for successful OPD ( Li et al., 2026b ) .
BSD instead uses a self-teacher, a copy of the student conditioned on the external teacher’s reasoning, so that the token-level guidance comes from the student’s own model and is therefore more compatible.
blocks.zh:
共享助学老师. Quen3-32B 校对:Soup
BSD在平均分上以3.3分到8.6分的成绩超过所有四个学生的SFT,而SFT则低于其中三个学生的基准模式.
因此,即使在同一模范家庭内,直接模仿一个更强大的教师推理,对较小的学生来说也是困难的(张等,2023;张等,2025.
BSD也匹配或超越了每个学生的"香草OPD":Qwen3–1.7B的平均分数中的两个平分分,而BSD的分数最高可比其他三个高出3.6分.
这表明,共享一种示意剂并不能确保不同模型之间的推理模式相容,而以前的工作认为这些模型对于OPD的成功很重要(Li等,2026b.).
BSD转而使用自教,即以外部教师推理为条件的学生的拷贝,这样象征级别的指导就来自于学生自己的模式,因此更加相容.

SFT可以大幅缩短其响应,并会使性能与封闭的API老师相撞而崩溃,而BSD和OPD则一般保持稳定的响应长度并在整个培训过程中显示稳定或改善性能.

blocks.en:
Cross-tokenizer teacher. Because the teacher model Nemotron-3-30B-A3B uses a different tokenizer from the students, xOPD must align the two tokenizations and map the teacher’s token probabilities onto the student’s tokens.
Nevertheless, xOPD does not yield consistent gains over the base models.
It improves the average score of Qwen3-0.6B by 3.4 points, but brings only marginal gains of 0.5 and 0.6 points for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-4B-Instruct , respectively, and decreases the score of Qwen3-1.7B by 0.8 points.
This indicates that constructing a mapping makes cross-tokenizer OPD possible, but does not guarantee effective token-level supervision.
In contrast, BSD improves all four base models by 1.2 to 4.4 points and outperforms xOPD for three of the four students,
with Qwen3-0.6B as the only exception.
BSD therefore provides a strong alternative for cross-tokenizer distillation, obtaining guidance directly in the student’s token space without mappings between distinct vocabularies.
blocks.zh:
跨接师子. 因为教师模型Nemotron-3-30B-A3B使用与学生不同的活字符号,xOPD必须将两个活字符号对齐,并将老师的活字符号概率映射到学生的活字符号上.
然而,xOPD并没有在基准模型上取得一致的收益.
它将Quen3-0.6B的平均得分提高3.4分,但只为Quen3-4B和Quen3-4B-Instruct分别带来0.5分和0.6分的边际得分,将Quen3-1.7B的得分减少0.8分.
这表明,构建一个映射可以使跨触控器OPD成为可能,但并不能保证有效的符号级监督.
相比之下,BSD改进了所有4个基模型,以1.2分到4.4分,并超越了4个学生中3个的xOPD,
以Quen3-0.6B为唯一例外.
因此,BSD为交叉触控器蒸馏提供了很强的替代品,直接在学生的符号空间获得指针,而不在不同的词汇之间绘制地图.

blocks.en:
Closed API teacher. GPT-5.6 Luna is accessible only through a text API and exposes neither token probabilities nor its tokenizer.
Moreover, it returns short final responses averaging 247 tokens, compared with about 4,000 tokens from the other two teachers.
Directly using these responses as SFT targets causes the students to imitate their length (cf. Section 5.2 ).
Consequently, SFT falls below the base model for three of the four students, with Qwen3-0.6B dropping from 10.8 to 2.8.
ROPD handles the lack of token probabilities by asking the external teacher to derive a rubric and score student rollouts during training.
BSD outperforms SFT for all four students by 3.1 to 9.7 points and ROPD by 0.6 to 3.6 points.
BSD achieves these gains by using each API response as privileged context for the self-teacher while allowing the student to generate its own rollouts, without training the student to reproduce their form.
blocks.zh:
关闭API老师. GPT-5.6 月光只能通过文本 API 访问,既不暴露符号概率,也不暴露其标致器.
此外,它还收到简短的最后答复,平均247个信使,而其他两名教师则收到大约4 000个信使。
直接使用这些答复作为SFT目标,使学生可以模仿他们的长度(参见第5.2节)。
因此,SFT低于四名学生中的三名学生的基准模式,Qune3-0.6B从10.8降至2.8.
ROPD通过要求外部老师在培训期间获得一个分数和分数来处理缺乏象征性概率的问题.
BSD以3.1分到9.7分,ROPD以0.6分到3.6分的成绩超过所有4名学生的SFT.
BSD通过将每个API响应作为自我老师的特权背景,同时允许学生自行推出,而无需培训学生复制其形式,从而实现这些收益.

blocks.en: 5.2 Training Progression
blocks.zh: 5.2 培训进展

blocks.en:
We further examine how distillation changes the students throughout training.
Figure 3 tracks two aspects of this progression: response length across all twelve teacher--student pairs and benchmark performance in a representative closed API setting. 2 2 2 More performance curves for other teacher–student pairs are provided in Appendix H , where SFT performance also frequently deteriorates over training.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步审查蒸馏法如何改变整个培训阶段的学生。
图3记录了这一进展的两个方面:所有12个师生对子的响应长度和在代表性封闭的API环境中的基准性能。 2个 2 其他教师-学生的成绩曲线在附录H中提供,SFT的成绩也经常因培训而恶化。

blocks.en:
Response length. Figure 3 a–c shows that the effect of SFT on response length depends strongly on the external teacher.
With the shared-tokenizer teacher, response lengths remain largely stable for all methods.
With the cross-tokenizer teacher, BSD and xOPD remain stable, whereas SFT usually increases the response lengths, most notably for Qwen3-1.7B .
The most pronounced shift occurs with the closed API teacher, whose responses average only 247 tokens.
SFT trains directly on these short responses, causing all four students to gradually shorten their outputs.
In contrast, BSD and the corresponding OPD baselines maintain relatively stable response lengths across all twelve pairs.
These trends show that using the external teacher’s reasoning trace as privileged context allows BSD to preserve the student’s output form without forcing it to reproduce the trace’s length.
blocks.zh:
反应长度。 图3 a-c显示,SFT对响应长度的影响在很大程度上取决于外部老师.
在共享触控器老师的帮助下,所有方法的反应长度基本保持稳定.
在交叉切除器老师的帮助下,BSD和xOPD保持稳定,而SFT通常会增加响应长度,最出名的是Qune3–1.7B.
最明显的转变发生在关闭的API教师身上,他的反应平均只有247个符.
SFT直接在这些短答上进行训练,使这四名学生逐渐缩短了产出.
相形之下,BSD和相应的OPD基线在所有十二对中保持相对稳定的响应长度.
这些趋势表明,利用外部教师的推理跟踪作为特权背景可以使BSD保持学生的输出形式而不会迫使学生复制跟踪长度.

blocks.en:
Performance. A substantial decline in performance accompanies the response-length drift under the closed API teacher.
Figure 3 d illustrates this behavior for Qwen3-4B-Instruct distilled from GPT-5.6 Luna .
SFT is already below the base model at the beginning, and its performance falls to nearly zero by the end of training.
The additional curves in Appendix H show similar collapses or declines of SFT in other teacher–student pairs.
These results further indicate that directly imitating a stronger teacher’s reasoning traces can lead to unstable training.
In contrast, ROPD and BSD maintain stable or slightly improving performance throughout training.
BSD is particularly notable because it uses the same external-teacher reasoning traces as SFT, but treats them as privileged context to guide the student’s own rollouts rather than as targets to imitate.
Appendix I further shows that SFT suffers from catastrophic forgetting on two out-of-domain benchmarks, whereas BSD does not.

blocks.en: 6 Further Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 进一步分析

blocks.en: 6.1 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 6.1 读取研究

blocks.en:
BSD combines privileged context from an external teacher with verifier-guided learning and applies token-level guidance only to unsuccessful rollouts.
We ablate these design choices by asking three questions: (1) whether privileged context itself improves learning , (2) how much reasoning the context should contain , and (3) whether the verifier and the restriction to unsuccessful rollouts are needed .
We study these questions in the shared-tokenizer setting using Qwen3-4B as the student and Qwen3-32B as the external teacher.
All variants use the same training problems and optimization setup.
blocks.zh:
BSD将来自外部教师的特权背景与核查者指导的学习结合起来,只对不成功的推出适用符号级指导.
我们通过提出三个问题来减少这些设计选择:(1) 特权背景本身是否改善了学习;(2) 环境应包含多少推理;(3) 是否需要核查人和限制不成功的推广。
我们用"Qune3-4B"作为学生,"Qune3-32B"作为外聘教师,在共享-toneders的环境下研究这些问题.
所有变体使用相同的训练问题并优化设置.

blocks.en:
BSD-trace , which uses the full reasoning trace as in the main experiments, serves as the reference.
For (1), we compare it with GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , which has no privileged context or self-teacher, and RLSD ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , which uses only the ground-truth answer while otherwise following BSD.
For (2), BSD-hint uses a three-sentence hint and BSD-guide uses up to eight reasoning steps without computations, both followed by the answer and derived from the full trace (obtained by using the prompts in Appendix B ).
For (3), BSD (w/ succ.) additionally weights successful rollouts, while OPSD ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) uses the self-teacher’s token-level signal on every rollout without a verifier.
Figure 4 reports training accuracy in panels (a)–(b) and Avg@4 in panel (c).
blocks.zh:
BSD-trace(BSD-trace ),它像在主要实验中一样使用全推理追踪,作为参考.
关于(1),我们把它与GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)比较,后者没有特权背景或自我教师,而RLSD(Yang等人,2026a年)则只使用地心真伪的答案,而在其他方面则遵循BSD.

对于(3),BSD(w/succ.)额外地加权成功推出,而OPSD(Zhao等,2026年)则在每次推出时使用自导师的符号级信号而无需验证.
图4报告了(a)-(b)和(c)Avg@4小组的培训准确性。

blocks.en:
Privileged context facilitates reinforcement learning. GRPO, RLSD, and BSD-trace exhibit nearly identical training-accuracy curves, with their average differences remaining below 0.2,
although BSD-trace shows a slight advantage in the middle of training (Figure 4 a).
Nevertheless, Avg@4 increases from 59.2 for the base model to 60.6 with GRPO, 61.7 with answer-conditioned RLSD, and 63.9 with trace-conditioned BSD.
Privileged context therefore improves how verifier feedback transfers to downstream problems.

尽管BSD-trace显示在训练中略有优势(图4 a).
尽管如此,Avg@4的基型由59.2加到60.6加到GRPO,61.7加到答有条件的RLSD,63.9加到痕有条件的BSD.
因此,在保密的情况下,核查反馈如何转移到下游的问题。

blocks.en:
More complete reasoning produces stronger gains. Changing the privileged context from a short hint to a full trace has little effect on the training dynamics, as the three variants follow similar accuracy curves (Figure 4 b).
However, BSD-hint scores 61.7, while BSD-guide reaches 62.5 and BSD-trace further improves to 63.9 (Figure 4 c), indicating that downstream performance benefits from more detailed reasoning in the privileged context.
blocks.zh:
更完整的推理产生更强大的收益. 将特权背景从短提示改为完全跟踪对训练动力学影响不大,因为三个变体遵循相类似的精度曲线(图4b).
然而,BSD-hint分数61.7分,而BSD-guide分数则达到62.5分,而BSD-trace分数则被进一步提高到63.9分(图4c),表明下游的性能得益于特权背景下更详尽的推理.

The verifier and the restriction to unsuccessful rollouts matter. BSD (w/ succ.) scores 61.4, below the 63.9 of BSD-trace, so extending the weight to successful rollouts does not help (Figure 4 c).
OPSD scores 59.7 and declines over training, from 63.3 at step 25 to 55.8 at step 150, while its responses on the benchmarks shorten from 16.8k to 12.5k tokens (Appendix D ).
The other variants keep the response length of the base model.

blocks.en: 7 Related Work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en:
Knowledge distillation. Knowledge distillation transfers supervision from a stronger teacher to a smaller student through output distributions or generated sequences ( Hinton et al., 2015 ; Kim and Rush, 2016 ) .
For reasoning models, this idea is commonly instantiated by training on teacher-generated reasoning traces, although large teacher–student gaps can make direct imitation difficult ( Shridhar et al., 2023 ; Hsieh et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Lyu et al., 2026 ) .
On-policy distillation instead learns from student-generated rollouts under token-level teacher guidance ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ) .
Recent variants extend OPD to heterogeneous tokenizers ( Minixhofer et al., 2025 ; Boizard et al., 2025 ; Niu et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) and black-box teachers ( Ye et al., 2026a ; Xiong et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , but typically require setting-specific supervision.
In contrast, BSD offers an effective and unified framework for all these settings.
blocks.zh:
知识分馏. 知识分馏通过输出分布或生成序列将监管从更强的教师转移到更小的学生(Hinton等,2015;Kim和Rush,2016.
对于推理模型,这种想法通常通过师生生成推理痕迹的培训来进行即时化,虽然师生的较大差距会使直接模仿变得困难(Shridhar等,2023;Hsieh等,2023;张等,2023;黄等,2026;Lyu等,2026).
相反,政策蒸馏法是在象征性教师指导下从学生产生的推广中学习的(Gu等,2024;Agarwal等,2024;Jin等,2026;Yang等,2026b)。
近期的变体将OPD扩展至多种活化剂(Minixhofer等,2025;Boizard等,2025;Niu等,2026;Sun等,2026)和黑盒教师(Ye等,2026a;Xiong等,2026;Fang等,2026;Zhou等,2026),但通常需要针对具体情况进行监督.
相比之下,BSD为所有这些设置提供了一个有效和统一的框架.

blocks.en:
Privileged information and self-distillation. Learning with privileged information provides a general framework for exploiting supervision that is available only during training, with generalized distillation connecting this idea to teacher–student learning ( Vapnik and Vashist, 2009 ; Lopez-Paz et al., 2016 ) .
In language models, context distillation instantiates this principle by internalizing information from instructions, demonstrations, or other contextual signals into a model that later operates without them ( Snell et al., 2022 ; Shin et al., 2025 ; Duan et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2026b ) .
Recent self-distillation methods further use the model itself as a privileged teacher by conditioning it on answers, solutions, feedback, or successful trajectories ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Penaloza et al., 2026 ; Hübotter et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026b ; Ding, 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Pan et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Kim et al., 2026 ) .
BSD follows this privileged paradigm, but uses reasoning from an external teacher as the privileged context.
blocks.zh:
私通相与自消. 使用特殊信息学习为利用监督提供了一个一般框架,这种框架只在培训期间提供,将这种想法与师生学习联系起来(Vapnik和Vashist,2009年;Lopez-Paz等,2016年)。
在语言模型中,上下文分馏通过将指令、演示或其他上下文信号中的信息内部化而成为日后运行的模型,从而将这一原则即时化(Snell等,2022;Shin等,2025;Duan等,2024;Ye等,2026b.).
最近的自我消化方法进一步将模型本身作为特权教师,以答案、解决方案、反馈或成功轨迹为条件(Zhao等,2026;Penoroza等,2026;Hübotter等,2026;Ye等,2026b;Ding,2026b)。 2026;刘等,2026;杨等,2026a;潘等,2026;李等,2026a;金等,2026.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced BSD, a unified framework for distilling from any teacher that provides reasoning traces.
BSD uses the external teacher’s reasoning trace as privileged context for a self-teacher, producing compatible token-level guidance in the student’s own token space without teacher probabilities or vocabulary mappings.
Across twelve teacher–student pairs spanning shared-tokenizer, cross-tokenizer, and closed API settings, BSD improves every base model and achieves the best or tied average performance among the distillation methods in eleven pairs.
Our analyses further show that BSD supports stable training, benefits from more complete reasoning, and focuses its guidance on uncertain tokens, establishing reasoning traces as a common and effective interface for on-policy distillation.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了BSD, 一个统一的框架 从任何教师那里提取 提供推理痕迹。
BSD将外部老师的推理追踪作为自导师的特权背景,在没有老师概率或词汇映射的情况下,在学生自己的信使空间中制作相容的符号级指导.
BSD 跨越十二个师生对子, 跨越了共享切除器, 交叉切除器, 以及封闭的API设置,
我们的分析进一步表明,BSD支持稳定的训练,从更完整的推理中获益,并将指导重点放在不确定的符号上,建立推理痕迹作为政策分解的共同而有效的接口.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
We evaluate BSD with shared-tokenizer, cross-tokenizer, and closed API
teachers across twelve teacher–student pairs and analyze its token-level
guidance. However, we acknowledge three main limitations.

blocks.en:
The case study in Section 6.2 shows a single response. Here we
compare the wording of responses across the three benchmarks, for the
base Qwen3-4B and the student trained with BSD on Qwen3-32B traces, with four samples per problem from each model.
On 26 problems the base model gives at least one incorrect response and
the BSD student at least one correct response; these comprise 45 incorrect
responses of the base model and 69 correct responses of the BSD student.
For every word n n -gram with n ≤ 3 n\leq 3 that is frequent in these
responses (1,508 n n -grams), we compute its rate per 1,000 words in
the two groups for each problem and a paired t t -statistic over the
problems. The rates of 24 n n -grams differ with | t | > 3 |t|>3 , where about
four are expected by chance; Table 12 lists examples.
Incorrect responses of the base model contain more expressions of
negation and doubt, and correct responses of the BSD student more
expressions of verification. The correct responses are also shorter,
with 19,057 tokens on average against 24,279. This comparison changes
the model and the correctness of the response at the same time, so the
differences cannot be attributed to BSD alone. We report them as a
description of the two groups of responses and not as independent
evidence that BSD induces self-correction.

whereas BSD and the OPD variants are not. On the MMLU-Pro
questions, SFT with GPT-5.6 Luna falls steadily from 62.1 at

questions, SFT with GPT-5.6 falls to 40.5 at step 100, 5.4
points below the base model. Under a bootstrap paired over questions,

the student’s own rollouts therefore preserves its abilities outside the
training domain, whereas imitating the teacher’s reasoning traces can erase
them.
